tools.name: lookup_mahjong_scoring_rules
tools.description: Compare high-level regional ruleset structures (tile deck size 136 vs 144 vs 152, hand length, and minimum Fan/point entry thresholds) across American, Chinese MCR, Japanese Riichi, and Hong Kong Mahjong. Do not use for Charleston passing steps, NMJL Joker meld legality, or Riichi Furiten checks.

tools.name: lookup_american_charleston_sequence
tools.description: Retrieve exact pre-game tile passing directions (Right, Across, Left), blind pass rules, and Courtesy Pass negotiation steps prior to the first discard in American Mahjong.

tools.name: check_nmjl_joker_legality
tools.description: Validate whether an American Mahjong Joker tile can legally substitute inside a specific meld size (1 to 6 tiles) and retrieve exposed Joker live-turn swap rules.

tools.name: check_riichi_furiten_and_yaku
tools.description: Evaluate Japanese Riichi Mahjong discard/temporary Furiten Ron restrictions and verify whether a hand satisfies the mandatory 1-Yaku win condition independent of Dora.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_mahjong_scoring_rules" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Look up official rules, minimum winning requirements, Joker/Dora usage, and Fan/Han scoring patterns across American Mahjong (NMJL), Chinese Official (MCR), and Japanese Riichi Mahjong." → after: "Compare high-level regional ruleset structures (tile deck size 136 vs 144 vs 152, hand length, and minimum Fan/point entry thresholds) across American, Chinese MCR, Japanese Riichi, and Hong Kong Mahjong. Do not use for Charleston passing steps, NMJL Joker meld legality, or Riichi Furiten checks."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
